max_temp_prediction: With peak heating typically arriving around 3–4 PM ET and the thermometer still rising at nearly 1°F/hr, at least 1–2 more degrees of warming appears likely before the daily max is reached. Confidence is moderate-to-high that the daily high will exceed 91°F, but the humid air mass and potential for afternoon cloud development introduce some cap on the upside beyond 93°F.
